'''William Esson''', FRS (17 May 1838 – 28 August 1916) was a British [[mathematician]].

==Early life==
He was born in [[Carnoustie]], [[Scotland]].<ref name=rasobit>Obituary notice, Fellow: Esson, William, ''[[Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society]], Vol. 77, p.299'', [http://adsabs.harvard.edu/full/1917MNRAS..77..299. 1917MNRAS..77..299.], The SAO/NASA Astrophysics Data System</ref>

Esson attended [[St John's College, Oxford|St John's College]], [[Oxford University|Oxford]].

==Career==
He then became a [[Fellow (college)|Fellow]] of [[Merton College]].<ref>[http://www.rsc.org/delivery/_ArticleLinking/DisplayArticleForFree.cfm?doi=CT9171100312&JournalCode=CT Obituary], Royal Society of Chemistry</ref> In 1892, he became the [[Savilian Professor of Geometry]] at the [[University of Oxford]], based at [[New College, Oxford|New College]]. He worked on problems in [[chemistry]] with [[Augustus George Vernon Harcourt]].

In 1869 he was elected a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]] and in 1895 delivered, jointly with Harcourt, their Bakerian Lecture ''on the Laws of Connexion between the Conditions of a Chemical Change and its Amount. III. Further Researches on the Reaction of Hydrogen Dioxide and Hydrogen Iodide''.<ref>{{cite web| url=https://collections.royalsociety.org/DServe.exe?dsqIni=Dserve.ini&dsqApp=Archive&dsqCmd=Show.tcl&dsqDb=Persons&dsqPos=0&dsqSearch=%28%28text%29%3D%27esson%27%29|title= Fellow Details|publisher= Royal Society|accessdate= 20 January 2017}}</ref>

He was on the governing body of [[Abingdon School]] until 1900.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.abingdon.org.uk/uploads/school/files/abingdonian/1900_July_V002_N018.pdf#page=11|title=School Notes|publisher=The Abingdonian}}</ref>

==Personal life==
In 1874, Esson leased 13 [[Bradmore Road]] in [[North Oxford]].<ref name="hinchcliffe">{{cite book | title=North Oxford | last=Hinchcliffe | first=Tanis | year=1992 | publisher=[[Yale University Press]] | location=New Haven & London | page=220 | isbn=0-14-071045-0}}</ref> He died in [[Abingdon, Oxfordshire|Abingdon]], [[England]].<ref>GRO Register of Deaths: Deaths SEP 1916 2c 348 ABINGDON — Willian Esson, aged 78</ref>
